_about: Public-domain James Hamilton (1814-1867, minister of the National Scotch Church, Regent Square, London) for the Word Hoard: his Works in the uniform edition (London: Nisbet, 6 vols, 1869-73: Life in Earnest, The Mount of Olives, The Royal Preacher, Emblems from Eden, Moses the Man of God and others), The Lamp and the Lantern (New York, 1853), raw Internet Archive OCR; and his Life of Bunyan, clean from Gutenberg. Not the other James Hamiltons; the translator of Tholuck's Hebrews (1842) is not claimed as him. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 16 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
